faq.title: Safety, privacy, and access
faq.subtitle: Common questions about how AlphaSeekers works.

access.a: AlphaSeekers supports Afghan students seeking free education. Access is reviewed to protect students and teachers.

privacy.a: No. Profiles and class details are not public. You control what you share, and access is limited to approved accounts.

cost.a: No. AlphaSeekers is free for learners and educators.

languages.a: The platform UI is available in Dari and English. Classes may be taught in different languages.

home.footer: AlphaSeekers is run by volunteers. All classes are free.

builtWith.title: Built with production-grade technology
builtWith.subtitle: Engineered for privacy, reliability, and accessibility in low-bandwidth environments.

rag.title: AI-Powered Study Assistant
rag.body: RAG pipeline with vector embeddings, semantic search, and streaming LLM responses.

i18n.title: Bilingual & RTL-First
i18n.body: Full Dari/English support with automatic RTL layout switching.

offline.title: Offline-Ready PWA
offline.body: Service worker caching, installable app, and schedule persistence for connectivity gaps.

notifications.title: Multi-Channel Notifications
notifications.body: Fallback chain across Telegram, Web Push, Email, and WhatsApp with retry logic.

scheduling.title: Automated Scheduling
scheduling.body: Teacher availability → session generation → Google Meet links → student reminders.

security.title: Role-Based Access Control
security.body: JWT auth, approval gates, rate limiting, and encrypted data at rest.

hero.subtitle: Free online classes for Afghan students, taught by volunteer teachers from around the world. Powered by AI. Built for low-bandwidth connections.

pipeline.title: From sign-up to your first live class
pipeline.subtitle: No fees. No complicated setup. Join a global classroom in minutes.

features.title: Built for learning, designed for Afghanistan
features.subtitle: Every feature exists because a real student needed it.

tabs.title: Live classes via Google Meet
tabs.desc: Students join live classes taught by volunteer teachers across multiple time zones. WhatsApp reminders ensure nobody misses a session. One tap from the dashboard opens Google Meet directly.

tabs.title: AI study assistant
tabs.desc: A bilingual AI tutor that answers student questions using actual course materials. Powered by a RAG pipeline with vector search, it responds in Dari or English and streams answers in real-time. Built to work on 2G connections.

tabs.title: Opportunities & library
tabs.desc: Browse curated scholarships, internships, and grants. Download free reading materials as PDFs for offline study during power outages.

tabs.title: Offline-first design
tabs.desc: Class schedules are cached locally. Forms auto-save during power outages. The entire platform works on a 2G connection with a $50 Android phone. Every kilobyte is accounted for.

mission.title: Education is a right, not a privilege
mission.body: When Afghan students lost access to education, we built a classroom that fits in a pocket. Free forever. Open to every student who wants to learn.

howItWorks.subtitle: No fees, no complicated setup. Just sign up and join a class.
